title: Princess Y95
description:
This 2023 Princess Y95 is a nearly new example of Princess's flybridge flagship, lying in Singapore. Twin MAN V12-2000 engines and a Sleipner vector fin system with zero-speed stabilisation deliver comfort underway and at anchor.

She features a walnut interior, a spa bath and crane on the flybridge, a beach club and twin Onan 50 kW generators.
